children: Trimble has acquired Terasat Japan, a virtual reference station service provider whose addition it said would give it boost its presence in Japan, the company said Tuesday.
Financial terms of the deal were not disclosed.

"The acquisition allows Trimble to now directly offer its VRS correction service in Japan, providing significant incremental coverage for real-time, centimeter-level positioning for the geospatial, construction, automotive and agriculture industries," the company said.
